name: tait-crt-interface-skill
title_zh: CRT 屏曲边加三档中文预设的夸张位图漫画窗
tagline_zh: 早期 Macintosh／Minitel 式窗口下面一张夸张的位图讽刺画，桶形弯曲的屏幕边，三套中文预设：街头怪诞、巨像符号、冷面几何。
tagline_en: An exaggerated bitmap editorial caricature beneath early Macintosh / Minitel-style windows, barrel-curved CRT edges, three Chinese presets.
desc_en: An exaggerated bitmap editorial caricature beneath early Macintosh / Minitel-style windows, barrel-curved CRT edges, three Chinese presets.
why_zh: 它禁止描摹和自动像素化——每个主体是重新绘制的独立身份，共用一套像素网格，中间调只许用受限的棋盘格。
why_en: No tracing, no auto-pixelation — each subject is re-authored as a distinct identity on one shared pixel lattice.
limit_zh: 生成前有两段强制问答：调色板和画幅比例没给就先问你。标题栏签名不可去掉。一次只出一张。正文 3.7 万字节，很吃上下文。
limit_en: A strict two-stage intake asks for palette and aspect ratio if not supplied; the title-bar signature is immutable; one image per run.
title_en: Exaggerated bitmap comic in CRT windows with 3 Chinese.
